Class Sightline

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.Sightline
public final class Sightline extends Object
Where a fighter's crosshair is in relation to its opponent: ground truth, used only to score it. The same sums whichever body the fighter has; the caller supplies the opponent as that body's client shows it.
